full_judgment:
24. Since the defendant has claimed that he had divorced plaintiff No. 1 by sending a postal notice on 06-10-1982, the burden of proof of the divorce is on the defendant. 

 25. To discharge his burden, the defendant adduced oral evidence by himself as DW 1 and also by the then Union Parishad Chairman (DW 3). Defendant also produced Exhibit-Ka being a postal receipt dated 06-10-102 showing the plaintiff No. 1 as the addressee. But such a postal receipt alone is not the sufficient documentary evidence to prove a legal divorce. Because this document does not prove the fulfillment of the requirements of section 7(1) of the Muslim Family Laws Ordinance, 1961 .This document, at best, raises a presumption under section 27 of the General Clauses Act that some letter was sent to the plaintiff No, 1 by registered post. But contents thereof remain unascertainable.
